methodology.resultUniverse: The fixed core matches the Standard Overall leaderboard: 12 configurations across 7 backbones, each with complete 198 / 198 coverage.
methodology.configurationAggregation: For each dataset, configuration accuracies are averaged within their shared backbone.
methodology.backboneAggregation: Backbone scores are then averaged with equal backbone weight within each taxonomy group.
methodology.weighting: The resulting group scores are averaged with equal dataset weight within the selected condition.
methodology.rankDefinition: Average Rank ranks the mutually exclusive groups within the active taxonomy on each dataset, using average ranks for exact ties.
methodology.outcomeDefinition: Best / Tied Best / Other counts whether a group is uniquely highest / tied for highest / below the highest within the active taxonomy on each dataset.
methodology.taxonomy: Evaluation Paradigm and Model Origin are separate taxonomies. Groups are mutually exclusive within each taxonomy and are never ranked across taxonomies.
methodology.privacy: Only aggregate condition-level statistics are published. Dataset identities, source mappings, backbone names, and configuration names are excluded.
